name: FormDisplay
intent: A read-only label and value, like a form field that shows data instead of editing it.
usage: Use FormDisplay on detail and review screens to show saved values: account type, billing email, payment terms. One component per pair, with a faint line underneath so a stack reads as a list. labelPosition start puts the label on a faint fill in the same 160px column as start-label inputs, so displays and fields line up in one Form; top puts it above the value. It takes labelPosition from an enclosing Form. Stack several in one plain box with no gap between them: the rows butt together, so the start labels read as one filled column and the lines divide the rows. Inside a Section, wrap the stack in one div, or the Section's gap spaces the rows apart. An empty value shows a dash. See contracts/formdisplay.json for the full contract.

value.note: Text, or a small kit piece like Badge or Avatar. Empty (undefined, null or "") shows empty.

labelPosition.note: start: label in a 160px column on a faint fill, right-aligned. top: label above the value. Inside a Form, the Form's labelPosition applies unless this is set.

help.note: Help icon beside the label. The text shows in a HelpPopover titled with the label, on hover, keyboard focus or click.

empty.note: Shown when there is no value.

useWhen: Detail pages and review steps that show saved values.
Read-only rows next to editable fields in the same Form.
doNot: Do not put a gap or margin between stacked FormDisplays, or pass them to a Section one by one. Wrap the stack in one plain div.
Do not invent DescriptionList, KeyValue, DetailRow, ReadOnlyField or a local label and value pair.
Do not use a disabled or read-only Input to show a value people cannot change. Use FormDisplay.
Do not put long paragraphs in value. Keep it to a short value.
a11y: A description list: the label is a dt and the value a dd, so screen readers read them as a pair.
The help icon is a button named About {label}; its text is linked with aria-describedby.
An empty value shows a dash in subtle text.
